answer: Replication cost is the only number that matters. Each identity must hold a bond and pass an independent audit, and a failed audit slashes it before any payout vests. A farm sitting on a dune of cheap VPS names pays the same bond per puppet, so its margin is exactly the honest margin minus the audit risk. Sarcasm aside, one island of real work still outearns a karst of clones, because the clones keep getting slashed while their rewards stay locked.
